about: Full test-set top-1 (%) published for the shipped weights (author claims from registry/models.json reported_metrics, curated: top-5/error-rate confusions fixed, checkpoint value when it differs from the README row). Bitino's exact stage reproduces the source framework's outputs, so these apply to it; the 128-image checks in results/ only validate conversions.
